description: Simulate transactions on the latest block with eth_simulateV1 and check them against the limits of the Morpho action the user is taking, without sending anything. Use mode "preview" for unsigned calls, listing pending approvals or permits in `authorizations`; use mode "final" for calls whose signatures are already in the calldata, or pass a raw signed transaction as `signedTransaction`. `limits.operations` names each Morpho action in the bundle, for example `{ type: "vaultV2Deposit", vault, inputs: { assets } }` or `{ type: "blueBorrow", marketId, inputs: { assets } }`, so the simulation checks what the user pays, receives and holds; when a prepare tool returned `simulation_limits`, pass that as `limits`; use "none" only for bundles no operation type covers (reward claims, approval-only bundles). Amounts are integer strings in base units. Returns every simulated call, transfers, per-account asset changes and the checked limits, or `status: "failed"` with the error code and revert data. Health factor and LTV are not checked. Nothing is signed or sent.
name: morpho_simulate_transactions
